title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant Accounts Assistant Finance Administrator Accounts Administrator

Crewe, Cheshire £30,000-£35,000 per annum Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm Predominantly Remote Occasional Travel to Crewe

Introduction

Acorn by Synergie is working in partnership with a well-established and growing business to recruit a Finance Assistant.

Joining a friendly and supportive finance team, you'll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the organisation.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with strong transactional finance experience who enjoys variety, accuracy and being part of a collaborative team environment.

The role offers a predominantly remote working arrangement; however, the successful candidate must be able to travel to the Crewe office at short notice when required. Therefore, applicants should be based within a commutable distance of Crewe, Cheshire.

You will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the business, ensuring processes run smoothly, deadlines are met and financial records are maintained accurately.

What We Offer
- Salary of £30,000-£35,000 per annum.
- Predominantly remote working.
- Supportive and collaborative team environment.
- Opportunity to join a growing and successful business.
- Varied role with exposure to a broad range of finance activities.
- Ongoing development and progression opportunities.
- Study support.

Key Responsibilities
- Process purchase invoices and reconcile supplier statements.
- Manage the sales ledger, raise invoices and allocate payments.
- Conduct credit control and maintain positive customer relationships.
- Perform bank reconciliations and support month-end processes.
- Prepare payment runs.
- Assist with accruals and prepayments.
- Maintain accurate financial records and documentation.
- Assist the Director with reporting and ad hoc finance tasks.

About You
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant or Accounts Assistant role.
- Strong knowledge of purchase and sales ledger processes.
- Confident carrying out reconciliations.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Well organised, with the ability to manage and prioritise workloads effectively.
- AAT qualified or currently studying towards AAT - desirable but not essential.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant, Finance Administrator or Accounts Administrator looking for a predominantly remote finance opportunity with occasional travel to Crewe, Cheshire, apply online today with your up-to-date CV.

title: Credit Controller
description:
A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a Credit Controller to join a welcoming and supportive finance team based in Wilmslow, with flexible remote working options available. This role offers the chance to be part of an organisation that values kindness, teamwork, and a positive outlook, where your interpersonal skills and commitment to excellent service will be truly appreciated.

As a Credit Controller, you will play a vital role in the finance team by managing debt recovery processes with sensitivity and professionalism. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve engaging with customers through various channels to chase payments while always maintaining a pleasant demeanour. You will be responsible for setting up direct debits, resolving queries with empathy, allocating cash accurately, and handling essential administrative tasks such as sending invoices.

Key duties include:
- Chase payment of outstanding debts through considerate communication via telephone, letter, and email while maintaining positive relationships with customers.
- Re-instate and set up new direct debits efficiently to ensure smooth transactional processes for clients.
- Resolve customer queries promptly by providing empathetic support and clear information to address concerns.
- Allocate cash accurately within the finance system to maintain dependable financial records.
- Perform administrative duties such as emailing copy invoices and supporting documentation in a timely manner.
- Collaborate closely with colleagues across departments to foster a communal approach to credit control activities.
- Build and nurture solid working relationships with both customers and internal teams by being approachable and responsive.
- Prioritise workload effectively to ensure all tasks are completed within agreed timelines without compromising quality.

The ideal candidate for the Credit Controller position brings proven experience in credit control processes along with transactional finance knowledge that supports accurate cash allocation. Your proficiency in Microsoft Office applications ensures efficient handling of administrative duties. A professional attitude paired with positivity makes you approachable for both colleagues and clients. Your strong work ethic drives consistent performance while your ability to prioritise tasks keeps operations running smoothly.
- Demonstrated knowledge of credit control processes and procedures is essential for ensuring accurate debt management.
- Experience in transactional finance provides you with the understanding needed for effective cash allocation and reconciliation.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook enables you to handle administrative tasks efficiently within the finance function.
- A professional attitude combined with a positive outlook helps create an atmosphere of trust among colleagues and clients.
- A strong work ethic ensures you consistently deliver high-quality results while supporting team objectives.
- Ability to prioritise workload allows you to manage multiple tasks simultaneously without compromising attention to detail.
- Negotiation skills enable you to resolve payment issues amicably while maintaining harmonious client relationships.
- Excellent communication skills empower you to connect with clients and staff at all levels in a polite and considerate manner.
- Capacity for generating solid working relationships demonstrates your commitment to collaborative success within the team.

This organisation stands out as an employer that genuinely cares about its people-creating an environment where every colleague feels valued, supported, and empowered. The culture is built on kindness, inclusivity, and teamwork rather than office politics or rigid hierarchies. Employees are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work each day; individuality is celebrated alongside communal success. The company's commitment extends beyond professional development: it offers generous benefits such as 25 days holiday plus your birthday off work, gym membership discounts for health-conscious individuals, healthcare support for peace of mind, childcare vouchers for family needs, opportunities to purchase extra leave for flexibility, pension contributions for future security-and much more. Fun yet professional attitudes prevail here; everyone shares responsibility for creating a positive workplace where likeminded individuals thrive together.

If you are enthusiastic about joining a supportive team where your skills are valued and your wellbeing is prioritised, don't miss this opportunity-apply now!

Apply today by clicking on the link provided.

title: Part time Payroll Administrator
description:
Part-Time Payroll Administrator

Location: Wilmslow

Role Overview

An established accountancy practice is seeking an experienced Part-Time Payroll Administrator to support its Payroll Manager with the accurate and timely delivery of payroll services.

title: Contact Centre Agent - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Credit Controller
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Adele Carr Recruitment - Credit Controller

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Credit Controller to join a busy accounts team, based at our Nantwich office.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is confident dealing with customers, has strong attention to detail, and is comfortable managing their own workload in a busy environment.

As Credit Controller, you will be responsible for managing outstanding customer accounts, ensuring payments are received on time and maintaining strong relationships with customers.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts
- Contacting customers by telephone and email regarding outstanding payments
- Allocating payments and maintaining accurate account records
- Investigating and resolving account queries
- Monitoring aged debt and taking appropriate action to reduce outstanding balances
- Agreeing payment plans where appropriate
- Working closely with the wider finance and commercial teams
- Producing regular debt reports and providing updates on outstanding accounts
- Ensuring credit control procedures are followed consistently
